dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend session_ = parse_json(session), turn_ = parse_json(turn), content_ = parse_json(content), retrieval_ = parse_json(retrieval), action_ = parse_json(action), control_ = parse_json(control)
| project
    TimeGenerated = now(),
    AstpVersion = tostring(astp_version),
    EventType = tostring(event_type),
    SessionId = tostring(session_['id']),
    SessionStartTime = todatetime(session_['start_time']),
    SessionUserId = tostring(session_['user_id']),
    SessionTenantId = tostring(session_['tenant_id']),
    SessionClientApp = tostring(session_['client_app']),
    SessionAgentId = tostring(session_['agent_id']),
    SessionConfigVersion = tostring(session_['config_version']),
    TurnIndex = tolong(turn_['index']),
    TurnTimestamp = todatetime(turn_['timestamp']),
    TurnModelId = tostring(turn_['model_id']),
    TurnModelVersion = tostring(turn_['model_version']),
    TurnTokensIn = tolong(turn_['tokens_in']),
    TurnTokensOut = tolong(turn_['tokens_out']),
    TurnLatency = toreal(turn_['latency']),
    TurnFinishReason = tostring(turn_['finish_reason']),
    ContentPromptText = tostring(content_['prompt_text']),
    ContentPromptHash = tostring(content_['prompt_hash']),
    ContentResponseText = tostring(content_['response_text']),
    ContentResponseHash = tostring(content_['response_hash']),
    ContentSystemPromptVersion = tostring(content_['system_prompt_version']),
    ContentRedactionApplied = tobool(content_['redaction_applied']),
    RetrievalDocumentIds = retrieval_['document_ids'],
    RetrievalChunkIds = retrieval_['chunk_ids'],
    RetrievalScores = retrieval_['scores'],
    RetrievalQueryText = tostring(retrieval_['query_text']),
    RetrievalSourceProvenance = tostring(retrieval_['source_provenance']),
    RetrievalPermissionContextCallerScope = tostring(retrieval_['permission_context']['caller_scope']),
    RetrievalPermissionContextDocumentScopes = retrieval_['permission_context']['document_scopes'],
    RetrievalPermissionContextScopeMatch = tobool(retrieval_['permission_context']['scope_match']),
    ActionToolName = tostring(action_['tool_name']),
    ActionToolArguments = action_['tool_arguments'],
    ActionResultHash = tostring(action_['result_hash']),
    ActionResultBytes = tolong(action_['result_bytes']),
    ActionPermissionDecision = tostring(action_['permission_decision']),
    ActionEgressTarget = tostring(action_['egress_target']),
    ActionContextDocumentIds = action_['context_document_ids'],
    ControlCanaryTriggered = tobool(control_['canary_triggered']),
    ControlPolicyVersion = tostring(control_['policy_version']),
    ControlBlockReason = tostring(control_['block_reason'])
